exampleMix.reason: Puyo supplies observable reaction constraints from a different game and a different role. Smash supplies a real challenger and documented patch scope. The historical original outcomes are reconstructed as labeled experiments.

01.focus: Falling pieces make the time-to-act constraint visible.

02.focus: The real puzzle establishes the observation. The model isolates clock coupling from a historical production case.

03.focus: Hold elapsed time fixed and compare resulting hunger times, then show why different hardware matters.

04.focus: Distinguish approaching challengers from Adventure mode and the two documented update numbers.

05.focus: Show a different later board state and finish with the equal-elapsed-time test.
